column1: # #409 — the arms of the card, one row each. Tab separated.
# Columns: arm, backbone seed. Nothing else changes between two arms.
# Add a row here and nothing else changes: every script and guard reads this
# file.
# Every arm runs the EMA momentum sweep's best arm, `r100_09` of
# reports/2026-08-19_ema_momentum_k32/. That is #373's cell
# `arm6_v2_combab_alignT` at k = 32 under the `mean` reduction, with
# `--align-target teacher` and an EMA momentum of 0.9 that rises to 1.0 at step
# 100,000. `study.sh` holds those values, and the momentum is the runner's own
# default.
# One extra factor in front of L_rep. It starts at 1.0 and falls linearly to
# 0.0 at step 10,000. There is no floor and no second shape, so the decay is in
# `study.sh` and not in a column here. Every arm carries it.
# This card runs NO control. The sweep measured this cell at two backbone
# seeds, and reports/2026-08-19_ema_momentum_k32/ema_momentum_k32.md holds
# both:
#   seed 20260524   GM-Relative MASE 1.1491
#   seed 20260520   GM-Relative MASE 1.1507
# The seed range is 0.0016. Read those two numbers from that report. A control
# arm here would spend a card on a number that exists.
# The card allows up to eight backbones and asks for repeat seeds. Every
# backbone goes to the decay arm, so the six give the decay arm's own mean and
# its own spread.
# Rows 1 and 2 carry the two seeds the sweep scored, so each pairs against a
# measured number. Rows 3 and 4 carry two seeds the sweep also trained on this
# cell, at another arm, and both held the contrastive task (AUC 0.978 and
# 0.975). Rows 5 and 6 are new.
# Six and not eight: the reference is two seeds with a range of 0.0016, so its
# mean is well determined, and past six the decay arm's own mean gains less
# than one more card costs. Two backbones stay unspent.
# `launch.sh` deals the rows round-robin over the two cards. So rows 1 and 2,
# the two seeds with a reference, land on different cards. One lost card does
# not take both.
# Seed 20260521 stays OUT. It lost the contrastive task once in the sweep, so a
# collapse there could not be read as the decay's.
# L_rep carries the negatives of this objective. Past step 10,000 nothing
# pushes the representations apart. The trainer writes the contrastive AUC to
# the `auc` column of <run>_losses.csv every step, and #409 adds `rep_w`,
# `l_rep` and `l_align` beside it. Read the AUC of every arm and name the step
# any run leaves the 0.95 to 0.98 band the sweep's healthy arms held.
